## What is infectious disease modelling?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A parsimonious representation of what we know
- Of the mechanism of interest, such as transmission, and of how we
  observe it
- Built to answer a specific question
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}

fig-alt="Model diagram redrawn from Davies et al. 2020. Susceptible
people become exposed after successful infection. After a latent period
they become either preclinical then clinical, both fully infectious, or
subclinical at half infectiousness. All move to removed through recovery,
with isolation also removing clinical cases."}
